concepts.title: International Business: Meaning and Its Reasons
concepts.definition: International business means production and trade transactions across national boundaries, embracing import and export of goods and services, foreign direct investment, and contract manufacturing, driven by unequal distribution of resources, lower costs abroad and division of labour and specialisation among nations.
concepts.key_idea: No country produces all it needs, so nations specialise where they hold advantages and trade for the rest, expanding markets beyond domestic boundaries.

solution_steps.explain: Confirm the transaction crosses national boundaries.
Check cost advantage, resources or market expansion.

concepts.title: Export Import Procedure and Documentation
concepts.definition: Export trade follows pre-shipment stages of enquiry, receipt of order, appointing agents, securing finance, obtaining export licence, pre-shipment finance and production, then shipment stages of customs clearance, mate's receipt, bill of lading and insurance, and post-shipment stages of invoicing, export documents, bills of exchange and realisation of proceeds.
concepts.key_idea: Key documents include proforma invoice, bill of lading, certificate of origin, letter of credit, bill of exchange and shipping bill for customs.
question_patterns: describe the main steps of an export procedure

solution_steps.explain: Sort the step into pre-shipment, shipment or post-shipment stage.
Name the document used at that step.
State what the document proves or secures.

concepts.title: WTO and the Framework of World Trade
concepts.definition: The World Trade Organisation established in 1995 as successor to GATT provides the institutional framework for world trade rules, promoting free and fair trade, reducing tariffs, and settling disputes among member nations covering goods, services and intellectual property.
concepts.key_idea: India is a founding member of the WTO, and the organisation's agreements aim at progressive liberalisation of trade for all members.

solution_steps.explain: Name WTO and its 1995 origin from GATT.
List rule making, liberalisation and dispute settlement.
Note goods, services and IPR agreements.
